We ran DeepSWE, Terminal Bench, Automation Bench, HLE, SciCode at 512K context on our DeepSeek UD3.1 GGUFs and show we're >10-20% better than GSQ-RCO

We ran all other benchmarks (14 in total) to 128K, fixed grading, infra. AIME2025 64x, DeepSWE/TB 3x, gpt-6-luna xhigh for HLE
posts.quoted: We benchmarked DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 GGUFs on Terminal Bench, DeepSWE & more on 512K context. Unsloth ranks highest overall. 1-bit Unsloth GGUF scores 68.1 on DeepSWE, 72.2 on Terminal-Bench, 52.7 on AutomationBench. >10% ahead of other quants.
